senses.gloss: m. (גבי) collector of taxes or charities, treasurer, manager.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 65b:3">Ned. 65ᵇ</cite> when one is reduced to poverty, <he>אינו נופל לידי ג׳ תחלה</he> he does not at once fall into the hands of the public almoner (but is taken care of by his friends).
Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ top; Tosef. ib. III, 4 חבר שנעשה ג׳ if a ḥaber (socius, v. חָבֵר 3) becomes a collector (publican), he is expelled from the order; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:4:4">Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:5:8">Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ</cite>; Y. Ned. IV, 38ᶜ <he>הניחו לַגַּ׳ שיגבה וכ׳</he> let the collector collect his debt, i.e. let the divine agency do its mission.—Pl. <he>גַּבָּאִים</he>, <he>גַּבָּאִין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:26">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 26</cite> <he>הג׳ והמוכסים וכ׳</he> for tax and custom collectors it is difficult to make reparation; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 94b">B. Kam. 94ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:17">Tosef. Dem. III, 17</cite> <he>גַּבָּאֵי צדקה</he> collectors or managers of charity.—

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:16">Ab. III, 16</cite> <he>הג׳ מחזירים וכ׳</he> the collectors (divine agencies of justice) go around every day; a. fr.—Chald. <he>גַּבּוֹיָיא</he>, pl. <cite ref="C00054"><he>גַּבּוֹיִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 4:7">Targ. Esth. IV, 7</cite> (Bxt. a. oth. <he>גַּבָּאִין</he>). [<cite ref="M00108"><he>גַּבְיָיא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C00076"><he>גַּבְיָא</he> I</cite>.]
